name: CannonBallMsg
meaning: Messages handled by CannonBall_HandleMessage 0x4a2d89 (senders: CanonSimple, CanonSheep, Rook 0x4e78ef, Pipe 0x4dadba/0x4dc69a)

name: MSG_CB_LAUNCH
meaning: arg Vec3s* dir -> state 1; a cannon sender becomes launcher and firedByCannon=1

name: MSG_CB_PLACE
meaning: arg Vec3s* pos; from a cannon: launcher + home pos + SetPosition; else SetPosition only when idle

name: MSG_CB_ENTER_PIPE
meaning: arg Vec3s* entry -> state 4; returns 1 (refused) in states 0/4/6

name: MSG_CB_PIPE_TRANSIT
meaning: arg = duration in g_gameTime ticks; sets up entry->current-pos interpolation

name: MSG_CB_PIPE_CAMERA
meaning: arg Vec3s* exit dir; computes camGoal, -> state 6

name: MSG_CB_LOAD
meaning: arg Vec3s* dir -> state 3 with the chase camera placed
